نكتتب (form VIII)
# نَكْتَتِبُ (naktatibu) /nak.ta.ti.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَتَبَ (iktataba)
# نُكْتَتَبُ (nuktatabu) /nuk.ta.ta.bu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَتَبَ (iktataba)
# نَكْتَتِبَ (naktatiba) /nak.ta.ti.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَتَبَ (iktataba)
# نُكْتَتَبَ (nuktataba) /nuk.ta.ta.ba/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
